THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

The poster's path

THE SCENE

Your art class is making posters for a show at the library. Your poster uses an old print and a photo of your friend. Before you hang it, you need four answers. Four people each have one.

THE HISTORY

This show is about a print shop in Mexico City. Artists opened it in 1937. They made prints together. Many prints had the shop's name, not one artist's name.
